description: This file defines a Polymer behavior called 'IronCheckedElementBehavior' for custom elements that have a 'checked' property. It includes property definitions, observers, and methods related to 'checked' state management, validation, and accessibility attributes. The behavior facilitates integration with forms and emits events upon state changes.

methods.name: _getValidity
methods.description: Returns false if the element is required and not checked; true otherwise, considering disabled and required states.

methods.name: _requiredChanged
methods.description: Updates the 'aria-required' attribute based on the 'required' property to aid accessibility.

methods.name: _checkedChanged
methods.description: Updates internal 'active' state and default value based on 'checked', and fires an 'iron-change' event.
